title: USS Paul Hamilton reports an object splashing down

tellings.quote: Uh 24 hours later the US was Paul Hamilton

plain: In 2019, off Southern California, the Navy destroyer USS Paul Hamilton is said to have reported an unknown object splashing down into the sea, about 24 hours after an earlier sighting. The writer Marik von Rennenkampff brings this up with Michels, drawing on the ship's deck log and an event briefing released under FOIA, a US law that lets anyone request government records. If true, the Navy's own records note an object that could go from the air into the water.
